newsitem.title: USA: D & P reaffirms Service Merchandise rating.
newsitem.headline: D & P reaffirms Service Merchandise rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it reaffirmed Service Merchandise Co Inc's $100 million of senior unsecured notes at Double B Minus and $300 million of senior subordinated debentures at Single B.
It lowered Service Merchandise's senior debt rating to Double B Minus from Double B and its senior subordinated debt rating to Single B from Double B Minus on February 19.

The rating action reflects the catalog showroom merchandiser's plan to close 60 stores and its Las Vegas, Nev., distribution center and take a $130 million pretax restructuring charge in the first quarter of 1997.
